docs.text: “It’s just a lake! Lakes don’t get big waves!” Lake Michigan, Holland State Park
the absolute STANK with which the narrator says “jean nicollet as wrong it was lake michigan not the pacific” has lived rent free in my head since 1992
I have a new neighbor who has discovered Lake Michigan: "There's sand! And waves even! It's like the ocean!"
one time i was with a german person who was seeing the great lakes for the first time and she said that's not a lake that's an ocean and i agree with her
My weekend sportscaster in LA asked someone in Chicago if he had a good view of the ocean. "You mean Lake Michigan?" Yeah yeah he said. The ocean This was on tv

She said, “because you tell me I accept it’s not actually the ocean”. But those of us who grew up with them know them for what they are. The first time I saw the pacific (1975) I was unimpressed. It looked like Lake Erie, with a different stink. Lunch in Chicago tomorrow, by the Lake.
I had a German friend visit Evanston a while back, and I took him to the beach. As soon as he saw Lake Michigan, he was like, "This isn't a lake, this is a sea."

Lmao my friend from England had that lesson. He was with some other friends at an amusement park that has a ferris wheel thing overlooking one of the great lakes. He asked if that was the Atlantic. A mutual friend was like no it’s a lake. “THATS NOT A LAKE! YOU CAN SEE TO THE OTHER END OF A LAKE!”.

Yes, but... Years ago, a friend overheard an argument between a Bostonian and a Chicagoan about the Great Lakes being just like an ocean. The Bostonian ended the debate in her best Southie accent with, "No shahks, no ocean!"

OTOH, we once listened to a visitor from Germany familiar with the plentiful but tinier lakes of Europe rhapsodize about the immensity of Lake Michigan. He went on and on about its oceanic qualities (it’s a little smaller than the Black Sea but bigger than the Caspian). I think it broke his brain.

I'm from Boston, and a friend of mine once overheard an argument between a Bostonian woman and a Chicagoan woman. Chicago claimed that Lake Michigan was just like an ocean. After going back and forth, Boston finally put an end to it with, "No shahks, no ocean!"

I'm always amused by visitors who don't realize how big Lake Michigan is. "Like this is a for real beach." 🤨
"It looks more like an ocean!" "Why is it so cold?" (it's deep, big, we get winter. ice. science.)
"I can't see the other side."
"Can you swim in it?" (watch out for the undertow)
Living on Lake Michigan was weird - brain said it was a sea, nose said it was a duck pond.
It’s always interesting seeing somebody who never saw Lake Michigan before. “THAT’S A LAKE?!” Yep 😎 I know, it’s giving ocean, but it’s a lake

Funny story: a friend f/ GA, flew up to Cleveland w/gf. In the air they wondered why they were near an ocean. Once landed they rushed to look at a map & were astonished to realize that ocean was Lake Erie
Not a Look How Dumb They Are story, they simply didn’t know any better.
Great Lakes be Great
My wife forever quotes whatever American Idol judge it was that, during auditions in Milwaukee, sat in the Calatrava with their back to Lake Michigan and declared how nice it was to be at the ocean.
